purpose: Recover the EXACT OOF inference semantics of the canonical Phase25D router and Phase25A/25C refiner so that Phase28 R1/R2/R3/F1 OOF replay is scientifically identical where it must be, and differs ONLY in the frozen ablated factor.

router_oof_inference_semantics.device: torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')  # trainer L209
router_oof_inference_semantics.autocast: NOT USED for router OOF prediction (no torch.autocast in the OOF block)
router_oof_inference_semantics.deterministic: no randomness at inference; seeds set per fold (42000+k) but not required for eval
router_oof_inference_semantics.normalization: apply_normalize with FIT_k mu/sigma ddof=0, constant<1e-12 -> 0.0 applied to SCALAR_NORMALIZE_IDX
router_oof_inference_semantics.fold_ownership: each OT sample predicted ONLY by its own fold model; never final.pt
router_oof_inference_semantics.non_reuse_note: Do NOT reuse the training AMP setting — router training used no autocast either; OOF inference is plain FP32.

refiner_oof_inference_semantics.device: model loaded on CPU (map_location='cpu'), model.eval(); input tensors stay on CPU
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.autocast: NOT USED — explicit comment 'FP32, no autocast' L117
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.input_construction: build_refiner_input: rgb uint8/255.0 (float32); prob float16->float32; concatenate [rgb, prob] axis=0
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.ordering: per domain, per outer fold k in (0,1,2), indices ascending, chunked by 8
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.fold_ownership: fold-specific canonical ROI-0.30 refiner whose OUTER_TARGET fold contains the sample; never final.pt
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.fusion: fuse_full_field: replace inside valid canonical ROI, leave p_global unchanged outside
refiner_oof_inference_semantics.trainer_side_amp_note: The Phase25A TRAINER used torch.amp.autocast(enabled=amp) for its ES loss (L519); the canonical OOF inference does NOT — 'Do NOT simply reuse the training AMP setting.'

phase25f_safety_oof_inference_semantics.note: Integrated-only. Reuses Phase25D CV5 fold ownership (F7 ruling); recompute deterministic 20-D S_omega feature vector from the (F1) candidate, then run the frozen cv_fold{k} S_omega model for that OUTER_TARGET sample.
